document: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021

clauses.title: Declaration of Unit Sale Price (USP)
clauses.text: The unit sale price shall be declared on pre-packaged commodities in rupees rounded off to the nearest two decimal places. For net volume/weight > 1 kg or 1 L, USP shall be declared per kg or per L. For net volume/weight < 1 kg or 1 L, USP shall be declared per gram or per millilitre.
clauses.evidence_text: The unit sale price shall be declared on the package in rupees, rounded off to the nearest two decimal places, per gram/millilitre/centimetre/piece or per kilogram/litre/metre.

clauses.title: Month and Year of Manufacture Requirement
clauses.text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be declared on every package in the format MM/YYYY or Month YYYY.
clauses.evidence_text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be declared on every package.
